content_zh:
博九刚走到楼下，就看到她的小管家陈晓东同学朝着她气喘吁吁的跑了过来，那眼神里带出了焦急很真切。
“你有没有伤到哪里？霍思雨她们是不是又……”
还没等陈晓东把话说完，博九就开了口：“被我揍回去了。”
“什么？！”陈晓东觉得自己跑了一路，耳朵都出问题了，艰难的问道：”少，少爷是说，你没挨打？“
博九挑眉：“我长的就这么像挨打货。”
关键是你以前确实是啊！
陈晓东在心里嘀咕了一句，他知道他家少爷自从醒过来之后就有那么一点点不同。
首先是气质，非常的撩人，但这不包括他可以对付霍思雨那一群人……
“那你刚刚有没有看到秦少？”陈晓东小心翼翼的问着。
博九伸了个懒腰：”没有。“
”没有就好！“陈晓东深深的松了一口气。
博九就奇怪了，怎么这些人一个个的，就好像生怕她遇到那什么秦少一样：“就算我遇到他又怎么了？”
“我怕你会直接抱住他的腿不走。”陈晓东说完之后，有点小幽怨的看了博九一眼：“少爷，你忘了你以前做过的事了？”
陈晓东不提醒还好，一提醒确实是有什么不堪的记忆直接涌上了博九的心头。
好像就是在这个食堂。
她对秦大神的背影一见钟情。
然后就……就说要包养人家！！！
博九是个不怎么能尴尬的人，现在也有点想捂脸。
不过她一个黑客女王，总要证明自己的清白：“之前说要包养他的那个人不是我。“
陈晓东一脸“你当我们全校师生的眼睛都瞎了吗”的表情。

又特意嘱咐了博九一句：“少爷，你听我说，你就算是喜欢男生！也不要对着秦少下手，他的身份咱们博家是真惹不起！差着好几个级别呢！”
”哦。“博九听的非常敷衍。
陈晓东顿下了脚步，一脸认真的晓之以情动之以理：“少爷，你就不能喜欢妹子吗？老板为了这件事已经对你有意见了，零花钱没了不说，还让你自己在学校里自生自灭。没准以后公司都不是你的，会交给外面养着的那一对姐弟，少爷就不着急吗？就算是为了夫人，咱不喜欢汉子了成不？”
闻言，博九顿下了脚步，眸子里浮出了一层冷冷的薄光。
她以前的事，基本上都是那一对姐弟给她捅到她爹面前的。
一开始的时候博忠义确实对博九很好，毕竟她博九才是他的第一个“儿子”。
可后来，这些耳旁风听多了。
博忠义对博九也越来越不喜欢，到了最后得知博九有可能是个弯儿的时候，便彻底断了博九的经济来源！
连带着家都不回了，更是对曾经和他共患难的博夫人不屑一顾。
博九对这样的渣男毫无好感。
当初博忠忠义之所以能成立公司，全靠着她的母亲财力支援。
现在博忠义什么都有了，就想把人一脚踹开？
天底下哪有这么好的事？
既然是她接收了这具身体，那就要把属于他们的，全部都拿回来！

content_en:
As soon as Bo Jiu walked downstairs, she saw her little housekeeper, Chen Xiaodong, running toward her panting, with real anxiety in his eyes.
"Did you get hurt anywhere? Did Huo Siyu and the others..."
Before Chen Xiaodong could finish speaking, Bo Jiu spoke: "I beat him back."
"What?!" Chen Xiaodong felt that he had run away all the way and his ears had problems. He asked with difficulty: "Master, the master is saying that you were not beaten?"
Bo Jiu raised his eyebrows: "I look like a beaten guy."
The key is that you really were before!
Chen Xiaodong muttered in his heart. He knew that his young master had been a little different since he woke up.
First of all, his temperament is very alluring, but this does not include his ability to deal with Huo Siyu's group of people...
"Then did you see Mr. Qin just now?" Chen Xiaodong asked cautiously.
Bo Jiu stretched out: "No."
"That's fine!" Chen Xiaodong breathed a deep sigh of relief.
Bo Jiu was surprised, why these people were all there, as if they were afraid that she would meet that young Master Qin: "What would happen even if I meet him?"
"I'm afraid you will hug his legs and stop him from walking away." After Chen Xiaodong finished speaking, he glanced at Bo Jiu with a little resentment: "Master, have you forgotten what you did before?"
It was okay if Chen Xiaodong didn't remind him, but when he was reminded, some unbearable memories flooded into Bo Jiu's mind.
It seems to be in this cafeteria.
She fell in love at first sight with Qin Dashen's back.
Then... he said that he wanted to support others! ! !
Bo Jiu is a person who can't be embarrassed very much, and now he feels like covering his face.
But as a hacker queen, she always has to prove her innocence: "The person who said I would support him before was not me."
Chen Xiaodong had an expression on his face: "Do you think all the teachers and students in our school are blind?"
He also specifically told Bo Jiu: "Master, listen to me, even if you like boys! Don't attack Young Master Qin. With his status, our Bo family really can't afford to offend him! He's several levels behind!"
"Oh." Bo Jiu listened very perfunctorily.
Chen Xiaodong paused, and Xiao Zhi with a serious face reasoned with his emotions: "Master, can't you like girls? The boss has already had a problem with you because of this matter. He has left you with no pocket money and asked you to fend for yourself in school. Maybe the company will not be yours in the future, and will be handed over to a pair of siblings raised outside. Aren't you anxious, Master? Even if it's for my wife, we don't like men, right?"
Hearing this, Bo Jiu paused, and a cold light appeared in his eyes.
Her past affairs were basically brought to her attention by the pair of siblings.
Bo Zhongyi was indeed very kind to Bo Jiu at the beginning. After all, she, Bo Jiu, was his first "son".
But later, I heard these things too often.
Bo Zhongyi also disliked Bo Jiu more and more. When he finally learned that Bo Jiu might be a crook, he completely cut off Bo Jiu's financial resources!
He didn't even return home, and he even looked down upon Mrs. Bo, who had been with him through thick and thin.
Bo Jiu has no good impression of such a scumbag.
Bo Zhongzhongyi was able to set up the company entirely because of the financial support of her mother.
Now that Bo Zhongyi has everything, he just wants to kick people away?
How can there be such a good thing in the world?
Since she accepted this body, she must take back everything that belongs to them!
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
